# Rosco

> Rosco is a Melbourne events team offering 360 photo booth hire (Rosco 360 Photo Booth), self-serve iPad photo booth hire (Rosco Photo Booth), and event photography and videography (Rosco Visuals) for weddings, parties and corporate events across Melbourne and Victoria.

- Phone: 0461 277 549
- Email: roscohq@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rosco_360_photobooth/
- Booking: a 30% deposit secures the date; all payments are made by PayID bank transfer.

## Services

- [360 Photo Booth](https://roscovs.github.io/360-booth): slow-motion 360 videos with instant sharing and an attendant. Essentials 3 hours $399, Signature 5 hours $699, Ultimate 7 hours $899. Up to 3 people on the platform at a time, or 4 on request.
- [Photo Booth](https://roscovs.github.io/photo-booth): self-serve iPad photo booth, delivered, set up and collected. Digital 2 hours $149, Digital 4 hours $199, Prints 2 hours $249, Prints 4 hours $349, All Night 6 hours $449.
- [Photography & Videography (Rosco Visuals)](https://roscovs.github.io/visuals): event, wedding and corporate photography and video. Photo 2 hours $450, 3 hours $590, 4 hours $750; Photo + Video 4 hours $1,590; Full Day 8 hours $3,290; team headshots 2 hours $450. Edited photos usually delivered within 7 days.
